# WorldEye

> WorldEye is a live 3D intelligence globe on the web. It puts 74,229 live public cameras, real-time flight and satellite tracking, weather radar, earthquakes and wildfires on one interactive globe. The map is free to use with no account; WorldEye Pro adds an AI analyst, satellite map view, global search and premium intelligence feeds.

## Product

- [Live globe](https://worldeye.app/): The WorldEye app — a live 3D globe with cameras, flights, satellites, weather, earthquakes and wildfires, free with no signup.
- [Features](https://worldeye.app/features): Everything WorldEye does — live layers, OSINT tools, the AI analyst and Pro capabilities.
- [Live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras): Browse 74,229 live public cameras worldwide — traffic, cities, landmarks, beaches, airports and nature.
- [God's Eye View](https://worldeye.app/gods-eye-view): How WorldEye compares as a hosted, no-install "god's eye view" of Earth with 74,229 cameras.

## Live cameras by country

WorldEye serves live camera pages for 109 countries, each with that country's real camera count, areas and playable feeds. The full index is at [Live cameras by country](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries). Largest networks:

- [United States live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/united-states): 41,355 live cameras
- [Japan live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/japan): 10,472 live cameras
- [Canada live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/canada): 4,685 live cameras
- [Taiwan live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/taiwan): 3,243 live cameras
- [Spain live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/spain): 2,120 live cameras
- [Austria live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/austria): 1,725 live cameras
- [South Korea live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/south-korea): 1,610 live cameras
- [Sweden live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/sweden): 1,569 live cameras
- [United Kingdom live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/united-kingdom): 1,403 live cameras
- [Hong Kong live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/hong-kong): 1,350 live cameras
- [Italy live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/italy): 1,030 live cameras
- [Thailand live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries/thailand): 118 live cameras
- [City webcams](https://worldeye.app/city-webcams): Live cameras browsable by city, with per-city counts and featured feeds.
- [Live traffic cameras](https://worldeye.app/live-traffic-cameras): Highway and road cameras, including per-country traffic camera guides.

## Live trackers

- [Live flight tracker](https://worldeye.app/live-flight-tracker): Real-time aircraft positions from ADS-B on the free globe.
- [Live plane spotting](https://worldeye.app/live-plane-spotting): Watch aircraft movements and airport activity live.
- [Satellite tracker](https://worldeye.app/satellite-tracker): The ISS, Starlink and thousands of satellites tracked live.
- [Space station tracker](https://worldeye.app/space-station-tracker): Follow the International Space Station in real time.
- [Ship tracker](https://worldeye.app/ship-tracker): Live vessel positions from AIS broadcasts.
- [Earthquake tracker](https://worldeye.app/earthquake-tracker): Earthquakes as they happen — magnitude, depth and location.
- [Weather tracker](https://worldeye.app/weather-tracker): Live weather radar and conditions on the globe.
- [Wildfire tracker](https://worldeye.app/wildfire-tracker): Active wildfires from satellite detection feeds.
- [Hurricane tracker](https://worldeye.app/hurricane-tracker): Live tropical storm and hurricane tracking.
- [Cyber threat map](https://worldeye.app/cyber-threat-map): Live cyber threat intelligence on the map (Pro intel layer).

## Comparisons and guides

- [Compare](https://worldeye.app/compare): Side-by-side comparisons of WorldEye with other live-map and OSINT tools.
- [God's Eye View alternative](https://worldeye.app/alternatives/gods-eye-view): WorldEye as a hosted alternative to the open-source God's Eye View project.
- [World Monitor alternative](https://worldeye.app/alternatives/world-monitor): How WorldEye compares with the World Monitor dashboard.
- [Google Earth alternative](https://worldeye.app/alternatives/google-earth): A live, real-time alternative to Google Earth's recorded imagery.
- [Best live webcam sites](https://worldeye.app/best-live-webcam-sites): A guide to the best sites for watching live webcams worldwide.
- [Best OSINT tools](https://worldeye.app/best-osint-tools): A guide to open-source intelligence tools, including WorldEye's free toolkit.
- [Blog](https://worldeye.app/blog): Guides and explainers on live tracking, cameras and OSINT.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://worldeye.app/pricing): Free globe for everyone. Pro is weekly $7.99, monthly $13.99 or annual $74.99 (VIP Pro). Free trials: 1 day on the weekly plan, 1 day on the monthly plan, and 3 days on the annual plan.
- [FAQ](https://worldeye.app/faq): Answers about the free map, Pro, trials, billing, cameras and privacy.
